about.title: About Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI estimates daily PM2.5 concentrations across all 54 African nations.
about.overview.problem_desc: Most African cities lack air quality monitors. We fill that gap.
about.how.step1.title: We watch from above
about.how.step1.desc: Air quality is measured from space, so we can cover places with no ground station.
about.how.step2.title: Ground Calibration
about.how.step2.desc: Checked against hundreds of real monitoring stations across Africa.
about.how.step3.title: Anywhere in Africa
about.how.step3.desc: You get an estimate for your area, not the nearest big city.
about.limit.intro: Important limitations to be aware of.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Thick cloud can hide the air below it, so some days are less certain.
about.limit.gap_desc: We look once a day, so a short spike can pass unseen.
about.who.citizens_desc: Check air quality before outdoor activities.

screen.trust.title: Trust & Transparency
screen.trust.intro: We show estimates from satellites and weather models so you can decide when to go outside. Here is what goes into those estimates.
screen.trust.calc_body: We estimate how much fine dust and smoke is in the air where you are, then turn that into a simple rating you can act on.
screen.trust.source_era5: Hourly weather from Europe's climate reanalysis (wind, humidity, temperature).
screen.trust.source_s5p: Satellite gas columns that help spot pollution plumes.
screen.trust.source_modis: Satellite aerosol optical depth for dust and smoke.
screen.trust.source_openmeteo: Fast weather fallback when primary feeds are slow or offline.
screen.trust.source_worldpop: Population density used to classify urban vs rural models.
screen.trust.source_openaq: Ground monitor readings when stations report nearby.
screen.trust.disclaim_body: Mframapa gives estimates, not measurements. There is no sensor on your street, so treat this as guidance. For medical or official decisions, use government monitoring.
